rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a brief period of rest or relief.

example.english: I can finally have a little respite and stop thinking about these worries.
example.traditional: 我終於可以休息一陣，唔使再諗啲煩心事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 jau1 sik1 jat1 zan6 m4 sai2 zoi3 nam2 di1 faan4 sam1 si6

rows.note: Use this for a temporary breathing space or relief, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: After days of negotiations, both sides finally got a brief respite.
example.traditional: 經過連日談判，雙方終於得到短暫喘息。
example.jyutping: ging1 gwo3 lin4 jat6 taam4 pun3 soeng1 fong1 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou3 dyun2 zaam6 cyun2 sik1
